name: Arnak's Hoof
summary: On Darkcloud Pinnacle, Arnak Grimtotem awaits execution for murder and kidnapping. Freewind Post's defenders marked him for death after he killed a fellow tauren and took the tauren's sister.

sections.title: Bounty on an Outcast
sections.body:
Across Thousand Needles, Arnak Grimtotem is feared as an outlaw. His brutality has crossed even the bitter divisions among tauren clans. He murdered a fellow tauren and abducted the victim’s sister, Lakota Windsong.

So the defenders of Freewind Post marked him for execution and set a bounty on his death. Arnak took refuge on Darkcloud Pinnacle, guarded by Grimtotem. His severed hoof proves to Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post that the murderer has answered for his crimes.

faq.q: What is Arnak's Hoof used for?
aliases: what do i do with arnak's hoof
faq.answer: Arnak's Hoof proves that the outlaw Arnak Grimtotem is dead. You bring it to Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post to fulfill the wanted bounty and claim the promised reward.
Arnak Grimtotem was a Grimtotem renegade wanted for murder and kidnapping. He killed a fellow tauren and held the victim's sister, Lakota Windsong, captive on the bluffs of Darkcloud Pinnacle.
You find Arnak on the cliffs of Darkcloud Pinnacle in northern Thousand Needles. Rope bridges near the crags approaching Razorfen Downs lead there. Lakota Windsong is held captive on the same bluff.

angles.text: As a tauren of the plains, you bring tribal justice by taking Arnak's hoof. His murders brought dishonor and bloodshed to Thousand Needles.
By eliminating Arnak, you uphold Freewind Post's authority in Thousand Needles. You also weaken the treacherous Grimtotem influence threatening Horde supply routes.
